They may be slow, but don't let your guard down! A horde of these can soak up a lot of damage...|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 7 ([[Polluted Wasteland]] [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]])}} {{QuoteBox|Incoming new zombies!|Beginning of Wave 7 (Pre-Overhaul, [[Polluted Wasteland]] [[Golden Mode|Golden]] & [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Radioactive''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] that appeared exclusively in [[Polluted Wasteland]] [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode and was a replacement for the [[Heavy]] in [[Polluted Wasteland]]. The '''Radioactive''' had a slightly slower speed than the [[Quick]] but also had significantly more health than it. The '''Radioactive''' was spawned by the [[Dark Necromancer]] and the [[Mystery]] upon its death in [[Polluted Wasteland]] [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode. ==Appearance== The '''Radioactive''' had green skin and bright white eyes, with what appeared to be green radiation fluid leaking out of its eyes and mouth. Its torso and legs were metal-plated dark green. It also wore a radioactive pack on its back. Its appearance was similar to that of the [[Abnormal]]. ==Strategy== *Place your defenses in the center of the map to deal as much damage as possible. **In hordes, the [[Demoman]], [[Rocketeer]] and [[Mortar]] can wipe them out. ***However, these towers have a slow projectile speed, which means that the '''Radioactive''' may be able to escape the explosion radius of these towers, due to its high speed. ***Additionally, they do very low damage at lower levels, so this is not recommended *You can use towers like [[Freezer]], [[Frost Blaster]] or [[Electroshocker]] to slow these down, as this enemy is fast. *As the '''Radioactive''' spawns quite early, you need cheap, yet effective, towers. **Ideal towers include the [[Soldier]], [[Cowboy]], [[Crook Boss]], [[Ace Pilot]] and [[Pyromancer]]. ***Be aware that the [[Pyromancer]] will speed this already fast enemy up by 15%. *It is important to defend against the '''Radioactive''' early on during the game, as their high health and fast speed will easily overpower you. **A lot of [[Military Base]]s and [[Ace Pilot]]s can be used to counter this. *A [[Militant]] can fare well against '''Radioactives''' early on during the game. ==Update History== *'''29 April 2020''' - [[Release v1.10|Release v1.10.0]] **'''Radioactive''' added. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **No longer appears in Golden mode as it has been removed. *'''8 May 2021''' - [[Overhaul v1.3|Overhaul v1.3.0]] **'''Radioactive''' removed. {{GoldenNuclear|[[Quick]]|Wave 5|Radioactive|Wave 7|[[Wasted Boss]]|Wave 10}} {{FallenNuclear|[[Quick]]|Wave 5|Radioactive|Wave 7|[[Wasted Boss]]|Wave 10}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Polluted Wasteland]]
